Reference

API reference

Every endpoint of the Quarter HTTP API, with parameters, request examples and response examples.

Every endpoint of the Quarter API, grouped by resource. Paths, parameters and body fields are generated from the API's OpenAPI document; descriptions and examples are written by hand and use the same schemas.

Authenticate with authorization: Bearer <API key> unless an endpoint says otherwise. Bodies are JSON. Errors use the shape described in Errors. GET /v1/openapi.json serves the current OpenAPI document without authentication.

Actions

Plan an action

POST/v1/actions/planAuth: API key

Runs the same intake as execute without dispatching: creates the action (or returns the existing one), validates, applies policy and returns the compiled plan. A later execute with the same intent dispatches this plan.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring; length 1 to 255YesSame fields as execute.
actionstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z_.]+$Yes
actorobjectYes
actor.typeuser, service, workflow, agentYes
actor.idstring; length 1 to anyYes
subjectstring; length 0 to 255No
inputany JSONYes
policystringNo
deadlinestring (date-time)No
metadataobjectNo

Execute an action

POST/v1/actions/executeAuth: API key

Creates the action, or returns the existing one with the same id. Validates the input against the ActionSpec, applies policy, compiles the plan and schedules dispatch. Idempotent on id: the same id and fingerprint never dispatch twice.

Returns 200 when the action is CONFIRMED, NOT_EXECUTED or COMPENSATED, and 202 for every other state. In managed mode the request waits up to wait milliseconds for the action to settle; in executor mode it answers immediately.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
waitinteger; 0 to 30000NoMilliseconds to wait for a settled state. Default 10000, maximum 30000. Managed mode only.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring; length 1 to 255YesYour stable identity for this business write. See action identity.
actionstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z_.]+$YesAction type, such as stripe.refund.create. See the actions reference.
actorobjectYes
actor.typeuser, service, workflow, agentYesWho asked for the write. Policies can require a type.
actor.idstring; length 1 to anyYesYour identifier for the actor.
subjectstring; length 0 to 255NoThe business object the write concerns. Filterable in GET /v1/actions. Part of the fingerprint.
inputany JSONYesProvider input, validated against the ActionSpec's inputSchema.
policystringNoReserved. The project's policy applies.
deadlinestring (date-time)NoReserved.
metadataobjectNoString key-value pairs recorded on the intent.

Record a shadow observation

POST/v1/actions/observeAuth: API key

Records how a provider call your own code made ended. Quarter stores it for the reliability report and never calls the provider. See Shadow mode.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
intentobjectYesThe intent, with the same fields as execute.
intent.idstring; length 1 to 255Yes
intent.actionstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z_.]+$Yes
intent.actorobjectYes
intent.actor.typeuser, service, workflow, agentYes
intent.actor.idstring; length 1 to anyYes
intent.subjectstring; length 0 to 255No
intent.inputany JSONYes
intent.policystringNo
intent.deadlinestring (date-time)No
intent.metadataobjectNo
observationobjectYes
observation.transportdispatched_response, ambiguous, throttled, not_dispatchedYesHow the call ended: dispatched_response, ambiguous, throttled or not_dispatched.
observation.httpStatusintegerNoProvider HTTP status, when there was one.
observation.providerObjectIdstringNoThe object the provider returned.
observation.durationMsinteger; 0 to anyNoCall duration.
observation.retryOfstringNoIdentifies the earlier attempt when this call is a retry.

List actions

GET/v1/actionsAuth: API key

Returns actions newest first, with cursor pagination.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
statestringNoOne state, or several separated by commas.
providerstringNoProvider name, such as stripe.
actionTypestringNoExact action type.
subjectstringNoExact subject.
sincestring (date-time)NoCreated at or after this time.
untilstring (date-time)NoCreated before this time.
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Export actions as CSV

GET/v1/actions/exportAuth: API key

Returns the project's actions as text/csv, oldest first, up to 100,000 rows, with content-disposition: attachment; filename="quarter-actions.csv". Takes the same filters as the list, including metadata.*, without paging. See Export as CSV.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
statestringNoOne state, or several separated by commas.
providerstringNoProvider name, such as stripe.
actionTypestringNoExact action type.
subjectstringNoExact subject.
sincestring (date-time)NoCreated at or after this time.
untilstring (date-time)NoCreated before this time.

Get a signed Outcome Proof

GET/v1/actions/{actionId}/proofAuth: API key

Returns the action's Outcome Proof signed with Ed25519. body adds tenantId, projectId, actionType and fingerprint, so the proof cannot be moved to another action or payload. Verify it offline with the keys from /v1/proof_keys. See Signed proofs.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Approve a held action

POST/v1/actions/{actionId}/approveAuth: API key

Answers a policy hold, such as review_above, before anything was sent. The action moves from NEEDS_REVIEW to AUTHORIZED and is dispatched. The approver is taken from the credential, recorded on the ledger and written into the Outcome Proof as approvedBy.

An action that is in review because its outcome is uncertain, not because a policy held it, returns INVALID_MANUAL_RESOLUTION (422). Resolve that one instead. The action.approval_required event tells you a hold is waiting. See Agent tools.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
notestring; length 0 to 1000NoOptional. Up to 1000 characters. Recorded with the decision.

Reject a held action

POST/v1/actions/{actionId}/rejectAuth: API key

Answers a policy hold by refusing it. Nothing was sent, and nothing will be. The action moves from NEEDS_REVIEW to NOT_EXECUTED with the reason REJECTED_BY_REVIEWER.

Rejecting an action that is not held by a policy returns INVALID_MANUAL_RESOLUTION (422).

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
notestring; length 0 to 1000NoOptional. Up to 1000 characters. Recorded with the decision.

Get an action

GET/v1/actions/{actionId}Auth: API key

Returns the current view of one action, including its Outcome Proof once it has one.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

List an action's events

GET/v1/actions/{actionId}/eventsAuth: API key

Returns the action's ledger, oldest first. See one action's timeline for event types.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Reconcile an action

POST/v1/actions/{actionId}/reconcileAuth: API key

Opens a new reconciliation run for an action in OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or NEEDS_REVIEW that has at least one dispatched attempt. In any other case it changes nothing. Always returns 202 with the current view.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Compensate an action

POST/v1/actions/{actionId}/compensateAuth: API key

Reverses a CONFIRMED action through the compensator its ActionSpec declares. The action moves to COMPENSATING, and the compensator runs as its own protected action with the id <actionId>:compensation. When the compensator confirms, the original becomes COMPENSATED. Returns 202 with both views.

An action type with no compensator, or an action in any state other than CONFIRMED, returns VALIDATION_FAILED (422). Few ActionSpecs declare one today; square.payment.create declares square.refund.create. See Compensation.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
reasonstring; length 3 to anyYesWhy the action is reversed. At least 3 characters. Recorded on the action's ledger.

Resolve an action

POST/v1/actions/{actionId}/resolveAuth: API key

Records an operator's decision for an action in NEEDS_REVIEW or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, with evidence of assurance MANUAL. The resolution is audited. See NEEDS_REVIEW.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
actionIdstringYesThe action id, URL-encoded.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resolutionCONFIRMED, NOT_EXECUTED, SAFE_TO_RETRYYesCONFIRMED, NOT_EXECUTED or SAFE_TO_RETRY.
reasonstring; length 3 to anyYesWhy. At least 3 characters.
operatorstringNoWho resolved it. Defaults to request:<request id>.
evidenceobjectYes
evidence.kindstring; length 1 to anyYesYour label for the evidence.
evidence.providerObjectIdstringNoRequired for CONFIRMED.
evidence.notestring; length 3 to anyYesWhat you checked. At least 3 characters.

Get proof keys

GET/v1/proof_keysAuth: None

Returns the public keys that sign Outcome Proofs and operation proofs, including keys being rotated out. Needs no key. Cache them and fetch again when a proof names a keyId you do not have. See Key rotation.

Specs

List providers

GET/v1/providersAuth: None

Returns every provider Quarter tracks, with how the provider identifies a repeated write (identity), how long it remembers that identity (keyLifetime), and the action types Quarter serves for it. Needs no key.

stage is implemented when Quarter has ActionSpecs for the provider, next when it is being built, and researched when only its idempotency behavior has been studied. actions is empty until a provider is implemented.

List ActionSpecs

GET/v1/specsAuth: API key

Returns a summary of every ActionSpec the API serves. The actions reference is generated from the same files.

Get an ActionSpec

GET/v1/specs/{provider}/{action}Auth: API key

Returns the full ActionSpec: identity, retry, reconciliation, evidence rules, redaction, input schema and known limitations.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstringYesProvider name.
actionstringYesAction name without the provider, such as refund.create.

Recipes and operations

List operations

GET/v1/operationsAuth: API key

Returns the project's most recent operations, newest first, including those started by a recipe.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Create an operation

POST/v1/operationsAuth: API key

Runs 1 to 20 steps in order as one operation. Each step is a protected action with the id <id>:step:<n>, started only when every earlier step is CONFIRMED. Returns 201 when it creates the operation and 200 when the same id and steps already exist. See Operations.

The same id with different steps returns ACTION_ID_CONFLICT (409). A step whose action has no active ActionSpec returns ACTION_SPEC_NOT_FOUND (422) before anything runs.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring; length 1 to 200YesYour id for the business operation, 1 to 200 characters.
actorobjectYes
actor.typeuser, service, workflow, agentYesuser, service, workflow or agent. Set once for every step.
actor.idstringYesYour identifier for the actor.
stepsarray of object; at least 1 items; up to 20 itemsYes1 to 20 steps, run in order.
steps[].actionstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z_.]+$YesAction type, such as square.payment.create.
steps[].inputany JSONYesProvider input, validated against that ActionSpec.
steps[].subjectstringNoThe business object the step concerns.
steps[].metadataobjectNoString key-value pairs recorded on the step's intent.
compensateOnFailurebooleanNoReverse confirmed steps, newest first, when a later step ends NOT_EXECUTED. Default false.

Get an operation

GET/v1/operations/{operationId}Auth: API key

Returns the operation's state and each step's action id, type and state. A CONFIRMED step has providerObjectId, the id of the object the provider created or changed; it is null otherwise. A step that has not started is PENDING. See operation states.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
operationIdstringYesThe operation id, URL-encoded.

Get an operation proof

GET/v1/operations/{operationId}/proofAuth: API key

Returns the signed manifest of a finished operation: each step's action id, state and the hash of its own Outcome Proof. It verifies offline with the keys from /v1/proof_keys. See the operation proof.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
operationIdstringYesThe operation id, URL-encoded.

List recipes

GET/v1/recipesAuth: API key

Returns every recipe with its version, steps and input schema. See Recipes.

Get a recipe

GET/v1/recipes/{name}Auth: API key

Returns one recipe. optional marks a step that runs only when its input is given.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
namestringYesThe recipe name, such as account.delete.

Run a recipe

POST/v1/recipes/{name}/runAuth: API key

Checks input against the recipe and every step's ActionSpec, then runs the steps in order as one operation with the given id. Returns 201 when it creates the operation and 200 when the same id and input already exist. The same id with a different input returns ACTION_ID_CONFLICT (409).

A step that does not fit its ActionSpec returns VALIDATION_FAILED (422) before anything runs; details.errors names the step and its action.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
namestringYesThe recipe name, such as account.delete.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring; length 1 to 200YesYour id for this business action. Step n runs as the action <id>:step:<n>.
actorobjectYes
actor.typeuser, service, workflow, agentYes
actor.idstringYes
inputobjectYesThe recipe input. See each recipe's input table in Recipes.

Events and webhooks

List webhook endpoints

GET/v1/webhook_endpointsAuth: API key

Returns the project's endpoints, newest first, with their delivery counts. Secrets are not returned.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Create a webhook endpoint

POST/v1/webhook_endpointsAuth: API key

Creates an endpoint and returns its signing secret, once. See Webhooks.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
urlstring; matches ^https?://YesWhere to POST events. Must start with http:// or https://.
eventsarray of action.confirmed, action.not_executed, action.outcome_unknown, action.needs_review, action.safe_to_retry, action.compensated, action.outcome_contradicted, action.approval_required, operation.completed, operation.failed, operation.compensated, operation.needs_review, provider.degraded, provider.recovered, *; at least 1 itemsNoEvent types to send, or ["*"]. Default ["*"].

Enable or disable a webhook endpoint

PATCH/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}Auth: API key

Sets enabled. Pending deliveries resume when an endpoint is enabled again.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesEndpoint id.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
enabledbooleanYestrue or false.

Delete a webhook endpoint

DELETE/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}Auth: API key

Deletes the endpoint and any deliveries still queued for it. To stop deliveries for a while instead, disable it with PATCH.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesEndpoint id.

List events

GET/v1/eventsAuth: API key

Returns project events newest first, with cursor pagination. See Events.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
typestringNoOne event type.
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Stream events

GET/v1/events/streamAuth: API key

A text/event-stream of project events as they commit, with a : ping comment every 15 seconds. Send Last-Event-ID to first receive up to 500 events after that id. The SDK reconnects with it automatically. See Stream events.

Shadow mode and audit

Build a reliability report

POST/v1/audit/analyzeAuth: API key

Combines ActionLint findings with the last 30 days of shadow observations. See the reliability report.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
findingsarray of object; up to 5000 itemsNoActionLint JSON findings. Up to 5000. Each needs rule, file, line, risk and confidence.

Sandbox test helpers

Inject a fault

POST/v1/test_helpers/faultsAuth: API key

Makes the simulated provider misbehave on the next write, or the next times writes; lookup_unavailable applies to reads. Faults queue in the order you inject them. Only for simulated sandbox projects: any other project gets VALIDATION_FAILED (422). An error from the simulator comes back as that error, never as a 200. See Inject a fault.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstringYesProvider id, such as stripe. An unknown provider returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND (404).
faulttimeout_after_commit, reset_after_commit, error_500_after_commit, error_500_before_commit, reset_before_commit, throttle, lookup_unavailable, version_driftYesWhat goes wrong. See Faults.
timesinteger; 1 to 50NoHow many calls it applies to, 1 to 50. Default 1.

List simulator effects

GET/v1/test_helpers/effectsAuth: API key

Returns the simulator's own record of every write it applied for this project, independent of anything Quarter concluded. ref is the idempotency key or client id Quarter sent, objectId the provider object. A CONFIRMED action has exactly one effect and a NOT_EXECUTED action has none. Simulated sandbox projects only. See Read what really happened.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstringYesProvider id, such as stripe.

Administration

Get the policy

GET/v1/policyAuth: API key

Returns the policy version the project points at: its rules, its agent budgets, and when it was created. id, version and createdAt are null and rules and budgets are empty when there is none.

Update the policy

PUT/v1/policyAuth: API key

Writes a new immutable policy version and points the project at it. See Policies.

A version is replaced whole: send the budgets you want to keep, because a body without budgets stores a version with none.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$NoPolicy name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 40. Defaults to the current policy, or default.
expectedVersioninteger; nullableNoFail with VERSION_CONFLICT unless the project is on this version. null means no policy yet.
rulesarray of object (one of several shapes); up to 100 itemsYesUp to 100 rules: deny_action, review_above or require_actor_type.
budgetsarray of object; up to 100 itemsNoUp to 100 agent budgets. Each limits one agent, or * for each agent separately, to a count of actions or recipe runs, or an amount in minor units of one currency, per fixed UTC minute, hour or day. overLimit is refuse (429 BUDGET_EXCEEDED) or hold for approval.
budgets[].idstring; matches ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$Yes
budgets[].agentstring; length 1 to 200Yes
budgets[].scopeobject (one of several shapes)Yes
budgets[].windowminute, hour, dayYes
budgets[].limitobject (one of several shapes)Yes
budgets[].overLimitrefuse, holdYes

List spec blocks

GET/v1/spec_blocksAuth: API key

Returns open and cleared spec blocks for the tenant, newest first. A block opens when a provider answers with an API version other than the one the ActionSpec was tested against (expectedVersion against observedVersion); actionId is the action that saw it. While clearedAt is null, new actions of that type are refused. See Spec blocks.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Clear a spec block

POST/v1/spec_blocks/{id}/clearAuth: API key

Clears an open block so new actions of that type are accepted again. Clear it only after checking that the provider's new API version does not change how the action behaves or how Quarter proves its outcome. Audited as spec_block.clear with your reason.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesSpec block id.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
reasonstring; length 3 to anyYesWhy it is safe. At least 3 characters.

Read an agent's budgets

GET/v1/agents/{agentId}/budgetsAuth: API key

Every budget that applies to one agent, including * budgets, with what it has used in the current window and what remains. used and remaining are in the limit's unit: actions or recipe runs for a count, minor units for an amount.

Windows are fixed UTC minutes, hours and days, so windowEnd is when the allowance resets.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
agentIdstringYesThe agent id, as in the actor { type: "agent", id }.

List provider webhook configurations

GET/v1/provider_webhooksAuth: API key

Returns the providers that have a webhook secret configured, with the path to register with the provider under your Quarter base URL. Secrets are not returned. See Provider webhooks.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Configure a provider webhook

PUT/v1/provider_webhooks/{provider}Auth: API key

Stores or replaces the signing secret for one provider's webhooks and returns the path to register. Until a secret is stored, every webhook for that provider is refused with 401. Audited as provider_webhook.configure.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstripe, shopify, twilio, clerk, resend, increase, mollie, zendesk, square, hubspotYesstripe, shopify or twilio.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
secretstring; length 8 to anyYesThe provider's signing secret. At least 8 characters.

List team members

GET/v1/teamAuth: API key

Returns the tenant's console users, oldest first, including disabled ones. Needs the owner role. Roles: viewer reads, developer also operates on actions, owner also manages keys, policy, webhooks and the team.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Add a team member

POST/v1/teamAuth: API key

Creates a console user in the tenant. Needs the owner role. An email that already has an account returns VALIDATION_FAILED (422). Audited as team.add.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
emailstring (email)YesThe member's email. Stored lowercase.
roleowner, developer, viewerYesowner, developer or viewer.
passwordstring; length 12 to anyYesInitial password, at least 12 characters.

Remove a team member

DELETE/v1/team/{id}Auth: API key

Disables the member and ends their console sessions at once. Needs the owner role. Audited as team.remove.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesMember id from the list.

List API keys

GET/v1/api_keysAuth: API key

Returns the project's keys, newest first, with the agent each is bound to. The key itself is never returned.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Create an API key

POST/v1/api_keysAuth: API key

Creates a key in the project's environment. The key is in this response only.

Pass agentId to bind the key to one agent: it can then act only as { type: "agent", id }, with the developer role, and cannot answer approval holds, so the agent cannot sidestep its budgets.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
agentIdstring; length 1 to 200NoOptional. The agent this key may act as.

Revoke an API key

DELETE/v1/api_keys/{id}Auth: API key

Revokes a key at once. The last active key of a project cannot be revoked.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesKey id from the list.

List customer-side executors

GET/v1/executorsAuth: API key

Each executor that runs provider writes inside your network, oldest first, with its status: pending until it enrolls, online if it polled in the last minute, offline otherwise, or revoked. In executor mode, work waits while no executor is online. Needs the owner role.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Issue an enrollment secret

POST/v1/executorsAuth: API key

Creates a one-time enrollment secret for one executor replica. Each replica enrolls once and keeps its own key, so run one enrollment per replica. The secret is shown only in this response. Needs the owner role; audited as executor.create.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
namestring; length 1 to 100YesA label for the replica, for example its host.

Revoke an executor

DELETE/v1/executors/{id}Auth: API key

Stops the executor from claiming work at once. Anything it was running is reconciled by your other executors, so enroll a replacement first if it is the last one. Needs the owner role; audited as executor.revoke.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstringYesExecutor id from the list.

List audit log entries

GET/v1/audit_logAuth: API key

Returns administrative changes for the tenant, newest first. See Audit log.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Get usage

GET/v1/usageAuth: API key

Counts the project's protected actions for one calendar month (UTC), by action type and state, and by reliability class. A protected action is one Quarter compiled a plan for; a retried request is still one action. This is the billing unit.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
monthstring; matches ^\d{4}-\d{2}$NoYYYY-MM. Default the current month.

Observed calls

List observed calls

GET/v1/callsAuth: API key

Returns the project's observed calls, newest first, each with the class Quarter gave it and its provider: the provider name where the host is one Quarter knows, else the host. Filter by provider, class, status, time or business id. Observed calls are kept for 30 days.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstringNoA provider name, such as stripe, or a host, such as api.stripe.com.
classsuccess, not_dispatched, lost_response, throttled, rejected_auth, rejected_input, conflict, not_found, provider_errorNoThe call class. See call classes.
statusinteger; 100 to 599NoThe HTTP status.
sincestring (date-time)NoObserved at or after this time.
untilstring (date-time)NoObserved before this time.
businessIdstringNoYour business id, as sent with the call.
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Record observed calls

POST/v1/callsAuth: API key

Stores metadata about 1 to 500 provider calls your process made. The SDK capture hooks send these for you; see Capture and observed calls. Quarter classifies each call from its method and status or error code, so a client cannot label its own calls.

Metadata only: a field outside the schema, such as a body, a header or a query string, fails the whole batch with VALIDATION_FAILED (422). So does a call observed more than 24 hours ago, or a route, business id or provider request id that looks like a credential. Nothing from a rejected batch is stored.

Observed calls are not protected actions. Recording a call never makes it retry-safe; only a reviewed ActionSpec does.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
callsarray of object (one of several shapes); at least 1 items; up to 500 itemsYes
calls[].observedAtstring (date-time)YesWhen the call started. Within the last 24 hours.
calls[].hoststring; length 0 to 253; matches ^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)*(:[0-9]{1,5})?$YesThe provider host, lower case, with an optional port.
calls[].methodGET, HEAD, OPTIONS, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETEYes
calls[].routestring; length 0 to 512; matches ^/[A-Za-z0-9._~:@{}/%+,-]*$YesThe path with ids and numbers replaced, no query string, such as /v1/charges/{id}/refunds.
calls[].statusinteger; 100 to 599NoThe HTTP status, when a response arrived. Send status or errorCode.
calls[].errorCodestring; matches ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]{1,63}$NoThe transport error code when no response arrived, such as ECONNREFUSED or UND_ERR_SOCKET.
calls[].durationMsinteger; 0 to 3600000YesTime to the response headers or the error.
calls[].attemptinteger; 1 to 100NoWhich attempt this is, from 1. Default 1.
calls[].idempotencyKeySentbooleanNoWhether the request carried an idempotency key. Default false.
calls[].providerRequestIdstring; matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$NoThe provider's request id, when you have it.
calls[].apiVersionstring; matches ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$NoThe provider API version, when you have it.
calls[].businessIdstring; length 1 to 255NoYour business id for the call, such as refund:order_1042.
calls[].shapeHashstring; matches ^(sha256:)?[0-9a-f]{64}$NoSHA-256 of the response's JSON key paths and value types. Never its values.
calls[].shapeany JSONNoThe key paths and value types the hash was computed from, for a successful JSON response. What drift detection compares.

Import OTLP traces

POST/v1/otlp/v1/tracesAuth: API key

An OTLP/HTTP trace endpoint in JSON. Point an OpenTelemetry exporter at it and every HTTP client span becomes an observed call on the same path as POST /v1/calls. Other spans are ignored. See OTLP import.

Only the method, host, route, status or error.type, start and duration are kept; every other attribute is dropped. A span that cannot be read, or started more than 24 hours ago, is counted in partialSuccess.rejectedSpans. Protobuf is not accepted yet.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
resourceSpansarray of anyNo

List drift leads

GET/v1/driftAuth: API key

Returns drift leads, newest first: routes whose successful responses changed shape from the baseline Quarter learned. breaking means a field was removed or changed type; informational means fields were only added. A lead is a label, never evidence. See Response drift.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
stateopen, resolved, all; default openNoopen (default), resolved or all.
providerstringNoA provider name, such as stripe, or a host, such as api.stripe.com.
kindbreaking, informationalNobreaking or informational.
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Resolve a drift lead

POST/v1/drift/{id}/resolveAuth: API key

Accepts the shape the lead saw as the route's new baseline, so the same change is not raised again. Do this once the code that reads the response handles the new shape. Needs the developer role. Audited as drift.resolve.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
idstring (uuid)YesThe lead id from GET /v1/drift.

Monitoring

Health check

GET/healthzAuth: None

Returns 200 when the API process is up. Needs no key.

Get project statistics

GET/v1/statsAuth: API key

Counts and latencies for a time window: actions by state, how many ambiguous outcomes were resolved automatically, time to a known outcome, duplicates absorbed, and actions that need attention.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
window1h, 24h, 7d, 30dNo1h, 24h, 7d or 30d. Default 24h.

Get reliability by provider

GET/v1/stats/providersAuth: API key

The same window as /v1/stats, broken down by provider: how many actions, how many came back ambiguous, how much of that Quarter proved on its own, how many wait on a person, and the p95 time to a known outcome. series counts actions and ambiguous ones per minute (1h), hour (24h) or day (7d, 30d), for charts.

verdicts counts the provider's actions by verdict class, so a rise in lost_response or throttled_not_dispatched shows up per provider.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
window1h, 24h, 7d, 30dNo1h, 24h, 7d or 30d. Default 24h.

List API requests

GET/v1/requestsAuth: API key

Returns the project's recent API requests, newest first. Use it to find a request by its quarter-request-id.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.
statusok, errorNook for status below 400, error for 400 and above.

Get provider health

GET/v1/providers/healthAuth: API key

Each provider's latest judged window: healthy, degraded or failing, the reasons, the call and verdict counts it was judged on, and the open incident if there is one. enoughData is false when the window had too few calls or actions to judge. stale is true when no window was recorded since, because the provider went quiet: its status is then its last, not its current. See Provider health.

policy states the rules providers are judged by: each signal's classes and its degraded and failing rates, minSample, and the incident rule (openAfter windows at threshold or worse to open, closeAfter healthy ones to close). Show these rather than copying the numbers.

List incidents

GET/v1/incidentsAuth: API key

Returns provider incidents, newest first. An incident opens and closes by the rule in policy.incidents of provider health. worstStatus and reasons describe the window that opened it, or the first failing window after that. See Incidents.

lastWindowEnd is the provider's latest recorded window. stale is true on an open incident whose provider went quiet: it can close only on healthy windows, and none are arriving. It is not evidence that the outage continues.

Query parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
stateopen, closed, all; default allNoopen, closed or all (default).
providerstringNoA provider name, such as stripe, or a host, such as api.stripe.com.
limitinteger; 1 to 200; default 50NoPage size, 1 to 200. Default 50.
cursorstringNonextCursor from the previous page.

Provider webhooks

Receive a provider webhook

POST/v1/providers/{provider}/webhooks/{projectId}Auth: Provider signature

The URL you register with Stripe, Shopify or Twilio. Your code does not call it. Quarter verifies the provider's signature with the secret from PUT /v1/provider_webhooks/{provider}, records the event once, and reopens reconciliation for up to 20 matching actions in OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, RECONCILING or NEEDS_REVIEW.

The event is a lead, never proof. It is attached as HEURISTIC_RECONCILIATION evidence and never settles an action by itself; the reopened reconciliation looks the object up at the provider and decides. A repeated event returns duplicate: true and changes nothing.

Signatures are checked in constant time. Stripe: stripe-signature must hold an HMAC-SHA256 of <t>.<raw body> in v1, with t within 300 seconds. Shopify: x-shopify-hmac-sha256 must be the base64 HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body. Twilio: x-twilio-signature must be the base64 HMAC-SHA1 of the full request URL followed by each form parameter name and value, sorted by name. Twilio signs the URL, so a proxy in front of Quarter must preserve host and send x-forwarded-proto.

Matching: Stripe events by the Quarter action id in the object's metadata, Shopify events by order id, Twilio status callbacks by the To number. Missing or wrong signatures, and providers with no stored secret, get 401 UNAUTHORIZED.

Path parameters

NameTypeRequiredDescription
providerstripe, shopify, twilio, clerk, resend, increase, mollie, zendesk, square, hubspotYesstripe, shopify or twilio.
projectIdstring (uuid)YesYour project id, from GET /v1/provider_webhooks.

Customer-side executor

Get plan signing keys

GET/v1/executor/keysAuth: None

Returns the public keys that sign plan envelopes, including keys being rotated out. The same keys as /v1/proof_keys. Needs no key.

Enroll an agent

POST/v1/executor/enrollAuth: None

Exchanges a one-time enrollment secret and the agent's Ed25519 public key for an executor token. The agent does this on first start. See Enrollment.

Body

NameTypeRequiredDescription
enrollmentSecretstringYesThe qe_ secret. Valid once.
publicKeyPemstringYesThe agent's Ed25519 public key, PEM.

Claim a job

POST/v1/executor/jobs/claimAuth: Executor token

Leases the next due execute or reconcile job for the agent's project. Returns 204 with no body when there is nothing to do. The envelope is signed by Quarter and expires after 60 seconds.

Report a job result

POST/v1/executor/jobs/resultAuth: Executor token

Reports what happened, in a body signed with the agent's enrolled key. kind is execute (an attempt result), verify (a read-after-write fact) or reconcile (a reconciliation fact). For execute, next is verify when the plan needs a read-after-write before it can conclude.
